realTimeInterviewAgent.name: Real Time Interview Agent
realTimeInterviewAgent.summary: An AI-assisted interviewing platform for HR teams and interviewers: it combines web-based preparation, desktop live support and collaborative analysis across the hiring lifecycle.

highlights.screening: Automated async screening interviews with invitation flow and predefined criteria
highlights.liveAgent: Live interview assistance: captures key points, answers and evaluates responses in real time
highlights.comparison: AI-powered comparison of interviews and candidates through natural-language analysis
highlights.collaboration: Centralized management of candidates, position searches and interviewer/recruiter collaboration

normsy.name: Normsy
normsy.summary: A nonpartisan project that blends human intervention with an LLM copilot to strengthen civic norms on social media: it identifies high-reach toxic threads, suggests constructive responses, and scales counterspeech without censorship or platform buy-in.

highlights.approach: "Human pilot + LLM copilot" model: users choose whether to intervene, which strategy to apply, and how much to edit
highlights.detection: Detection and scoring engine on X/Twitter to prioritize threads with high toxicity and high impact potential
highlights.recommendation: Recommendation engine with 20+ social science-backed strategies (empathy, humor, reframing, values-based appeals)
highlights.impact: Early evidence from an April 2025 study (n=1,021): reduced support for norms-violating posts and higher perceived harm

agentLuncher.name: Agent Launcher
agentLuncher.summary: MVP of the CCM Agent Launcher Service: a web platform to create, configure, and execute intelligent agents across multiple LLMs (Grok, Gemini, and GPT), focused on comparative analysis of multi-agent reasoning.

highlights.multiModel: Create and run agents on different LLM providers within the same workspace
highlights.configurable: Intuitive UI to define variables (e.g., ticker), customize prompts, and organize agents with tags
highlights.groupRuns: Grouped executions to launch multiple agents in parallel using shared instructions
highlights.comparativeView: Comparative response visualizations to analyze reasoning behavior differences across agents
